Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan

SPECIFICATION FOR 

MANIPULATORS, UTERINE, 

DR PURANDARE'S PATTERN 



( Reaffirmed 1997) 



1- Scope — Covers dimensional and other requirements for Dr Purandare's pattern uterine 
manipulators of Types I and II. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1 and 2.

FIG. 2 UTERINE, MANIPULATOR, DR PURANDARE'S PATTERN, TYPE II 



2.1 A deviation of ±2'5 percent shall be allowed on all dimensions. 

3- Material — Stainless steel conforming to Designation 20Cr13 or 30Cr13 of IS : 6603-1972 ' Specifi- 
cation for stainless steel bars and flats '. 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The manipulators shall be smooth and free from burrs, pits, cracks, scales and other surface 
defects. 

4.2 The opening and closing movements shall be smooth and jerk-free. 

4.3 Manipulators shall be matt fmished and passivated. 

4.4 The two halves shall be symmetrical and uniform. 

5. Heat Treatment — The manipulators shall be hardened and tempered to give a hardness of 
400 to 460 W/. 

6. Tests 

6.1 Flexibility — Fix each arm in a vice so that the entire arm projects above the vice. By gradual 
application of force on the fmger loop, deflect the arm by 15 mm in the same plane as the finger 
loop. The arm shall not take a permanent set or break. 



18:8458-1977 

6.2 Corrosion Resistance — Test the manipulators in accordance with 15:7531-1975 ' l\/lethod for 
boiling and autociaving test for corrosion resistance of stainiess steel surgical instruments '. The 
manipulators shall show no sign of corrosion after the test, 

7. Marking ~ The manipulators shall be marked with the manufacturer's name. Initials or recognized 
trade-mark. 

7.1 ISI Certification Marliing— Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — The manipulators shall be wrapped in moisture-proof paper or packed in polyethylene 
bags. The manipulators shall then be individually packed in cartons.
